newsitem.title: USA: U.S. propane stocks build in week to 24.1 mmb.
newsitem.headline: U.S. propane stocks build in week to 24.1 mmb.

text.p: U.S. propane stocks rose by 800,000 barrels in the week ending March 21, moving to within the lower limits of normal range for the first time since early February 1997, government data showed Wednesday.
The Energy Information Administration report said stocks were at about 24.1 million barrels, a level reached due to a high level of imports into the U.S. Gulf Coast.
The Gulf Coast recorded a nearly 1 million barrel increase in the week to 10.46 million barrels, which is slightly below the minimum level for the last three years, the EIA said.
The East Coast and Midwest both declined by 100,000 barrels to 3.59 million barrels and 9.36 million barrels, respectively, the EIA said.
